input: Find gymnastics, cheer, tumbling, trampoline and ninja camps for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Blue Ridge Kids Center summer camp 2026

candidates.name: Asheville Community Movement
candidates.note: Movers and Shakers summer day camp combines gym activities with weekly themes; summer 2026 confirmed.

candidates.name: Hahn's Gymnastics
candidates.note: Weekly summer day camps and supervised summer evening gym events; June–August 2026 confirmed.

candidates.name: Olympic Start Elite Gymnastics Academy (OSEGA)
candidates.note: Summer camps include gymnastics, ninja obstacles, trampolines, foam-pit activities and crafts.

candidates.name: Ninjaville
candidates.note: Summer half-day ninja camps use obstacle training, gymnastics, parkour and games.

candidates.name: Fearless Athletics
candidates.note: Weeklong summer camps and one-day cheer and tumbling skill clinics for varied ages and levels.

candidates.name: URJ 6 Points Sports Academy
candidates.note: Jewish overnight sports camp; gymnastics and cheer/dance majors announced for summer 2027.
